source_policy: Previously dated checkpoints and all previously pinned instruments are unchanged. New instruments and their execution receipts are retained.
initial_integrity_check: The first retained-evidence verifier invocation wrote its result to scratch, so the final link check found the as-yet absent checkpoint Verification.json. The failure is retained in Verification_Bootstrap_Failure.json. Redirecting the unchanged verifier to the checkpoint output path resolves this packaging-order issue; no numerical result or certificate changed.
precision_model: Nominal extra displacement delta around certified intervals. Machine intervals round outward; range methods use their actual endpoints, derivative allowances use nominal delta with derivatives evaluated on outer boxes. Membership is fixed.
scalar_range_scope: Endpoint and critical-value sums enclose the marginal finite Gaussian range. They do not retain common-ordinate correlations between rows.
higher_uncertainty_scope: At delta 5e-3 the retained stationary rows identify 73 targets and leave 18 candidate domains unresolved. This exclusion fixed point is not a feasibility certificate.
no_new_completeness_claim: Existing finite root-count certificates and analytic tails are reused. No global RH/GRH, field identification, optimal precision threshold or research exhaustion is asserted.
